content.value: Non-book equipment needs an open enchantment slot before the table offers anything. A book behaves as if it has one slot. The table offers independent level-1 enchantments: 1 option below 11 bookshelves, 2 options at 11–21, and 3 options at 22 or more. Options require character levels 10, 20, or 30 respectively, cost 1, 2, or 3 levels, and always consume 32 lapis.

Adept / Greater / Perfect: +9 / +12 / +15 Dexterity.
Body: weapons leech 1% / 2% / 3% physical as life; armour gains +45 / +60 / +75 maximum health.
Desert: +20 / +30 / +40 fire damage on weapons or 14% / 18% / 22% fire resistance on armour.
Glacial: +7 / +15 / +20 cold damage or 14% / 18% / 22% cold resistance.
Storm: +13 / +20 / +30 lightning damage or 14% / 18% / 22% lightning resistance.
Inspiration: +10 / +20 / +30 mana on kill or 15% / 18% / 21% mana regeneration.
Iron: 16% / 18% / 20% physical damage or matching increased armour, evasion, and Energy Shield.
Stone: 15% / 20% / 30% knockback or 10% / 15% / 20% knockback resistance.
Vision: +90 / +120 / +150 flat armour penetration on martial weapons.
Vein Mining: breaks matching connected ores from one mined block.

Press G while holding a tool with registered toggleable enchantments to cycle none disabled, each one disabled, and all disabled when several are present. This is useful for Silk Touch and Vein Mining behaviour. A grindstone refuses a damageable item below half durability; a successful grind adds damage equal to half maximum durability.
Enchantment Effectiveness scales modifiers created by enchantments only. It does not scale rune or native item modifiers.
